title: Adding opt-in file_system list param: backend query serializer, generated schema, and terminal mocks move together
answers: Files API meta.content_type missing in tests
Why does file_system list validate query params explicitly?
body:
`include_content_type` on the file_system list endpoint (posthog/api/file_system/file_system.py) is validated by a BooleanField query serializer (invalid values return 400), which also supplies the OpenAPI schema. Explicit validation is used because the query-only validated_request decorator would replace the ModelViewSet list-response inference (responses=None) and cause an operation-ID collision.
Content-type enrichment must key by each row's team (short IDs can collide across environments) and check backing-object viewer access via entries_missing_access_level using the backing object's creator; denied objects get neutral `application/json`.
Change together: file_system.py, frontend/src/generated/core/api.schemas.ts (FileSystemListParams), terminal callers, and mocks/stories that must now include `meta.content_type` (TerminalScene.stories.tsx, posthogFilesystem.test.ts).
applies: posthog/api/file_system/file_system.py list endpoint and terminal consumers
